SMB inbound from sales enablement tooling. Team = 18 people (sales + eng). Primary goal: reduce SDR after-call work by auto-generating 3-4 line call summaries + bullets for CRM. Key quotes from call: "We need summaries that are safe to attach to Salesforce — no raw PII unless we opt-in". Primary concern is PII exposure in transcripts (customer phone numbers, emails, credit-card-like strings). They expect to start with Hosted API (self-serve) and scale to Dedicated only if cost/latency justifies.

Technical: experimenting with streaming summaries vs batch post-call. Target: streaming summary available within 2-3s of call end; acceptable token cost < $0.015 per call on average. Currently using open-source STT externally; Redwood would take text -> summarization. Asking whether Redwood stores request/response payloads by default and how to configure retention.

Security ask: SOC2 mention is fine but legal wants explicit instructions for auto-delete, redact-on-ingest options, and KMS support (they have a low-cost key rotation requirement). Also want logs/audit trail per-team member.

Commercial: SMB price sensitivity. Interested in free credits to do 2-week POC (up to ~1,000 calls). If POC looks good, likely convert to pay-as-you-go hosted_api. Potential upsell to Optimize later.

Actionables (from AE notes): 1) Send short doc: hosted API retention defaults + how to enable auto-purge; 2) Provide sample policy text for PII deletion & sample curl showing no-store header; 3) Share estimate on token cost for 1k calls/week (include embedding+summary cost).
